## 5. One Non-Obvious Thing I Noticed

**The surveillance infrastructure is running better than the portfolio.**

WOLF fired 47 consecutive 5-minute heartbeat commits today — a perfectly disciplined telemetry loop — while the portfolio it monitors has been sitting in a non-compliant, halted state for **6 straight days**. The instrument that measures the problem is functioning flawlessly; the instrument that fixes the problem (`mandate_rebalance.py`) has not cleared the halt since 2026-05-13.

This is a common systems pattern: monitoring is easy to automate, remediation is hard. The heartbeat loop gives a false sense of activity. Bobby sees commits flowing all day, but zero trades have executed, zero mandate violations have been corrected, and the portfolio is still $100K in the hole on margin. **The commit graph looks healthy; the balance sheet does not.**

The non-obvious risk: if this pattern continues through the Day-60 reassess (2026-06-05), WOLF will hit the graduation gate with a clean telemetry record and a broken portfolio. The gate checks Sharpe, max-DD, and consecutive profitable weeks — all of which require trades to actually execute. High commit velocity cannot substitute for trade execution.
